defects.title: predicted CVI unevaluable for 54 of 61 classifier classes
defects.behaviour: gates on CLUSTOPT_CVIS = {calinski_harabasz, davies_bouldin, silhouette, dbcv} and ML2DAC_ONLY_CVIS = {dunn_index, coggins_jain_index, cop}, and returns float("nan") for every other class. 54 of the 61 classifier classes fall through to that NaN branch.
defects.scientific_consequence: _oriented maps NaN to -inf, so every candidate ties at -inf; the strict "oriented > best" comparison never fires and the incumbent stays the FIRST valid candidate, which is the top-ranked warmstart of the nearest neighbour. The predicted CVI has no influence on selection at all.
defects.computability: not a limitation of the metrics: ViewMetricEngine._clustopt_raw builds a GenericCVIEvaluator for an arbitrary metric list, so all 58 ClustOpt classes were computable. The gate set was simply never widened when the M1/M2/M3 variants were added.
defects.corrected: all 61 classes evaluated through their frozen canonical implementation

defects.title: unknown CVI direction silently defaults to MINIMIZE
defects.behaviour: returns value if CVI_DIRECTION.get(cvi) == 'maximize' else -value; CVI_DIRECTION holds only the 7 original CVIs, so any of the other 54 classes is silently treated as MINIMIZE
defects.scientific_consequence: a direction was applied that was never declared for the metric
defects.status_in_stage3a: latent in Stage 3A because defect 1 made every value NaN first; it would fire the moment defect 1 is fixed
defects.corrected: explicit direction for every class from the frozen registry; unknown ids raise CVI_CLASS_UNKNOWN

defects.title: dunn_index and coggins_jain_index sign-inverted
defects.source: external/ml2dac/src/ClusterValidityIndices/CVIHandler.py::CVI.score_cvi negates MAXIMIZE-objective scores; unified_mkr/ml2dac_cvi_adapter.compute_ml2dac_only passes the negated value through; ML2DAC/indomain/mkr.py CVI_DIRECTION then marks dunn_index and coggins_jain_index as maximize
defects.behaviour: score_cvi returns an optimizer loss for MAXIMIZE objectives; CVI_DIRECTION then maximises it
defects.scientific_consequence: maximising a negated score minimises the true index, so the WORSE partition is preferred

behavioural_evidence.expected: a well-separated partition should score better

defects.corrected: upstream MetricObjective read from the vendored CVI object; the loss convention inverted exactly once

downstream_claim_policy: the Stage-3B statement that ML2DAC CVI selection collapses coincides exactly with the arms whose predicted CVI was never evaluated (M1 158/324, M2 216/324, M3 230/324, M0 0/324). Whether that collapse is a property of ML2DAC meta-learning or an artefact of defect 1 cannot be settled without a decision on Stage-4 scoring semantics, and no Stage-3 replay is proposed here.
stage3_claims_requiring_a_confounding_la: any Stage-3 claim resting on M0/M1/M2/M3 FINAL SELECTED clustering performance. These must not be used as evidence that a richer CVI inventory harms or fails to help ML2DAC. Upstream classifier analyses that occur before the scoring stage remain valid.
